label: JZ Mock A · Paper 2 · Question 8
knowledgePattern: Linearise a reciprocal recurrence and telescope its product sum
solution:
All terms are positive. Put bn=1/an. The recurrence gives bn+1=bn+1 with b1=1, so bn=n and an=1/n.

Now anan+1=1/[n(n+1)]=1/n−1/(n+1). For a finite upper index N, the sum is 1−1/(N+1).

As N grows without bound, the last fraction tends to zero. Hence the required sum is 1. Answer B.
